headline.caveat: Meta holds 20% of the ~$14B venture; a pro-rata share would be ≈$2.8B, but Meta's actual equity contribution is not disclosed

nature_md: Meta holds 20% of the El Paso, TX data-center venture (Project Sopaipilla Holdings), with funds managed by BlackRock (Global Infrastructure Partners and HPS Investment Partners) holding 80%. Total development cost is ~$14B for a 1GW campus; Meta will be the sole occupant on completion (expected 2028). The venture issued $12.5B of notes at 7.53% (see related edge). The structure repeats the Hyperion playbook: majority third-party equity, SPV-level debt, Meta lease — and the campus stays off Meta's balance sheet.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Equity-method investment for Meta's 20%; neither the ~$14B of assets nor the $12.5B of SPV debt consolidates onto Meta. Meta's lease payments will run through opex once the campus delivers. Disclosure of any Meta guarantees (e.g., residual-value support analogous to Hyperion's) was not included in the announcement.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: SPV records Meta's contribution as 20% of member equity alongside GIP/HPS's 80%; combined with the $12.5B note issuance this funds the ~$14B build.
